Container.Name: switch-library-manager-web
Container.Overview: Manage your Nintendo Switch backup library from the browser: missing updates, DLC and games, issues, organizing and renaming, NSZ compression (with an estimate of what each file saves, and pause and resume), complete packs and the split of multi-title files (SuperNSP), in bulk, and an SD card planner. Use it with a game controller like a console. Discover games you might like, upcoming releases and your series, see statistics, your year on Switch, the version history of each game and, optionally, how long games take to beat (IGDB). Quick search, notifications, user accounts with protection against bots, 11 languages. Use it with backups of games you own. Put your own prod.keys (and optionally title.keys), dumped from your console, in the appdata folder or upload them from Settings; no keys or games are included or downloaded. Provided as it is, without any warranty (AGPL-3.0): keep a backup of your games.

Container.Changes: ### 1.65.2 - Tasks by covers says Skipped in orange for a game that cannot be compressed, as one in sparse storage, instead of Error ### 1.65.1 - Tasks by covers tells the step of each file, with its bar split in steps, each in its colour - The bars of work going on are blue with moving stripes, and series are blue until complete ### 1.65.0 - Place new files puts the loose files, like the uploaded ones, in the folder their game has, also from the automations - Game folders can be kept as they are, with a subfolder for the base game, and Chinese or Korean names no longer leave a folder named with a number - Tasks by covers fills up in order and in blue, with the files waiting darkened and bars that no longer jump ### 1.64.0 - The Compress page tells why each file cannot be compressed - The free space is weighed before files are written, and the list of games to combine warns of a DLC that needs a newer update - Packs are called Combine now ### 1.63.1 - Tasks by covers shows every file of the task, waiting, at work or ended, with the covers in their colours - The parts of Tasks fold with a click on their title, and the covers of the bars are no longer darkened ### 1.63.0 - The signature of Nintendo on every NCA is checked, with Check signatures on the Issues page in seconds - Organize names a DLC by its number with {DLC_NUMBER}, and can keep the names that have their title ID - The list of packs tells what each pack holds and shows the games packed before - Tasks can be seen by covers, each file filling up with its progress and with OK or Error once done ### 1.62.0 - The bot of Telegram answers in its chat: whether a game is in the library, what is new, the space, the tasks and a synchronization - Space shows each group as one line with its count and size, which opens to list its files ### 1.61.0 - Update now: on Windows, macOS and Linux the app installs a new version by itself, checked against the checksums of the release, and can go back to the one before (Docker and Unraid keep updating the container) - Uploading a game with a long name in Japanese no longer fails on the ZFS disks of Unraid ### 1.60.1 - The language flags of the cards have the shape and the size the region flags had ### 1.60.0 - Up to three preferred regions, in order, by the zones of the eShop (Europe, the Americas, Japan...), in Settings and the wizard - Game cards show the languages of the game as flags, and the region only when it tells something - The wizard plays a short welcome when it starts ### 1.59.0 - A game you have from several regions can show as one card with the flags of all its regions; choose its main copy on its page, or a preferred region in Settings ### 1.58.1 - Space no longer waits for compressed copies already checked in part or damaged, so Verify now does what it says, and deleted files leave the list as they go ### 1.58.0 - Users shows the last sign-in of each user and Activity the sign-ins of the login page; Space waits only for files really waiting for their check; a game compressed during a task downloads as its compressed copy; the count of files of a task counts each file once done; Measure picks a heavier setting from 5% faster ### 1.57.5 - Downloads without the version in their names, one copy only of an old update kept for its cheats, marks of games nothing can compress kept after Organize, and Check new files says when there is nothing to check ### 1.57.4 - Games whose file name starts with a dot are in the library again, and empty folders that were empty already or hold only Thumbs.db, desktop.ini or .DS_Store are deleted too ### 1.57.3 - Folders by ID with every DLC in the DLC folder if chosen, shorter folders for DLC, and "DLC [ID]" for a DLC without a name ### 1.57.2 - Old DLC versions deleted by the cleanup again, the sound copy kept instead of a damaged one, and the copy checked whole kept between duplicates ### 1.57.1 - Icons read from the game files kept after every scan, interrupted tasks with the time they ran, and the cleanup of duplicates finds the copy that stays with three copies or versions ### 1.57.0 - Organize renames in its folder a file whose name is taken at the destination and shows its changes in groups, new name fields {PACKAGE_CONTENTS}, {SIZE_GB} and {SIZE_MB}, why a game is not compressed, and the Compress page at the level of Settings ### 1.56.1 - With no connection, synchronizations and covers stop trying after a few attempts, the saved titles database is used and Tasks tells why ### 1.56.0 - Game cards (XCZ) and NSZ in blocks 4 to 6 % smaller, decompression and checks up to twice as fast, macOS with the fast zstd library, and automatic threads and Measure this server on all the processors but an eighth ### 1.55.0 - The queue of tasks can be put in order and tells when it is done, Organize tells the files it left and why, and games the titles database does not list get their updates, publisher and IGDB details ### 1.54.0 - Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, caches and covers. Put your prod.keys (and optionally title.keys) here.

Config.Name: Switch library
Config.Description: Share with your NSP, NSZ, XCI and XCZ files, e.g. /mnt/user/switch. Read and write, to organize and compress files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that runs the app; 99 is nobody, the owner of Unraid shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that runs the app; 100 is users.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for dates and scheduled synchronizations.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Optional: an administrator, with the password below. Users can also be created in the app.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional: password of the administrator above.

Config.Name: Allow remote access without login
Config.Description: Optional: set to true only if another service (a proxy with its own login, a VPN) protects the app. Without users, the app otherwise only answers on the local network.

Config.Name: Allowed names
Config.Description: Optional, only without login: other names the app is opened by, separated by commas (addresses, the server name and .local or .lan names always work).

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional: set to cloudflare when Cloudflare connects to the app directly, so the login protection sees the real visitor address (not needed with a Cloudflare Tunnel or a proxy on your network). Also takes proxy addresses or ranges, separated by commas.

Config.Name: IGDB Client ID
Config.Description: Optional: the Client ID of your own Twitch application (dev.twitch.tv/console), to show how long games take to beat, from IGDB. Can also be set in Settings.

Config.Name: IGDB Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional: the Client Secret of the same Twitch application.
